terms.heading: Terms of Service

s1.heading: 1. Agreement to Terms
s1.p1: By accessing or using Foundation Exclusive ("the Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you do not agree to these Terms, you may not access or use the Platform.
s1.p2: Foundation Exclusive is an exclusive NFT marketplace that operates as an extension of the Foundation ecosystem. Our platform caters to high-value collectors and creators who seek premium digital art.

s2.heading: 2. Eligibility
s2.intro: To use Foundation Exclusive, you must:
items: Be at least 18 years of age
Have the legal capacity to enter into binding contracts
Not be prohibited from using the Platform under applicable laws
Have a valid cryptocurrency wallet compatible with our Platform

s3.heading: 3. Account Registration
s3.intro: To access certain features of the Platform, you may be required to create an account. You agree to:
items: Provide accurate, current, and complete information
Maintain and promptly update your account information
Maintain the security of your account credentials
Accept responsibility for all activities that occur under your account
Notify us immediately of any unauthorized access to your account

purchasing.heading: Purchasing NFTs
purchasing.intro: When you purchase an NFT on Foundation Exclusive, you agree that:
items: All sales are final and non-refundable
You are responsible for all gas fees and transaction costs
Ownership is transferred upon successful completion of the blockchain transaction
The Platform is not responsible for any errors in wallet addresses or transaction details

creating.heading: Creating and Selling NFTs
creating.intro: If you create or sell NFTs on the Platform, you represent and warrant that:
items: You own or have the rights to the content you mint
Your content does not infringe on any third-party intellectual property rights
Your content complies with all applicable laws and regulations
You will accurately describe your NFTs and not engage in misleading practices

s5.heading: 5. Platform Fees
s5.intro: Foundation Exclusive charges fees for certain services:

items.label: Transaction Fee:
items.text: A percentage of each sale is retained by the Platform

items.label: Minting Fee:
items.text: A fee is charged when creating new NFTs

items.label: Creator Royalties:
items.text: Original creators receive royalties on secondary sales as specified

s5.outro: All fees are subject to change. Current fee structures are displayed during the transaction process.

s6.heading: 6. Prohibited Conduct
items: Use the Platform for any illegal purpose or in violation of any laws
Upload content that is infringing, defamatory, or harmful
Engage in market manipulation, wash trading, or fraudulent activities
Attempt to interfere with or disrupt the Platform's operations
Use automated systems or bots without our express permission
Impersonate others or misrepresent your identity

s7.heading: 7. Intellectual Property & NFT Ownership Rights
s7.intro: The Platform and its original content, features, and functionality are owned by Foundation Exclusive and are protected by international copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws.

buying.heading: What Buying an NFT Gives You
buying.text: When you purchase an NFT on Foundation Exclusive, you acquire verifiable ownership of that specific digital collectible edition — a unique, blockchain-recorded token representing your place in the provenance of the work. This grants you the right to hold, display, transfer, and resell the edition you own, along with a limited, non-exclusive, non-commercial license to showcase the associated artwork for personal use (for example, as your profile picture or in a personal digital gallery).

creatorRights.heading: What Remains With the Creator
creatorRights.intro: Ownership of an NFT edition is distinct from ownership of the underlying creative work. Unless a separate written agreement with the creator states otherwise, the original creator retains all copyright, reproduction, commercial-use, licensing, and derivative-work rights in the art, media, or content tied to the NFT. This means that, without the creator's express written permission, NFT holders may not:
items: Reproduce, print, or otherwise copy the underlying work for distribution or sale
Use the work commercially, including on merchandise, in advertising, or within other products or services
Sub-license, syndicate, or grant third parties rights to the underlying work
Create derivative works, adaptations, or remixes based on the underlying work
creatorRights.outro: In short: owning the NFT means owning the collectible — the authenticated, tradeable token itself. It does not transfer the creator's copyright or any of the broader commercial rights in the work the token represents. Creators are free to continue licensing, reproducing, and commercially exploiting their own work independent of any NFT sale, except where explicitly restricted by a separate written agreement.

s8.heading: 8. Disclaimers
s8.p1: THE PLATFORM IS PROVIDED "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE" WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND. WE DO NOT GUARANTEE THE ACCURACY, COMPLETENESS, OR RELIABILITY OF ANY CONTENT ON THE PLATFORM.
s8.p2: NFT values are highly volatile and speculative. We make no representations about potential profits or losses. You acknowledge that you are solely responsible for your investment decisions.

s9.heading: 9. Limitation of Liability
s9.text: TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW, FOUNDATION EXCLUSIVE SHALL NOT BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES ARISING FROM YOUR USE OF THE PLATFORM.

s10.heading: 10. Taxes for Local and International Users
s10.p1: As a U.S.-based company, all users within the United States and certain users located outside the United States may be required to pay applicable taxes, fees, or government-imposed charges associated with the use of our services, where required by applicable law or our billing policies. Any such taxes or fees, if applicable, must be paid through the Platform on an annual basis in accordance with the payment instructions provided.
s10.p2: Failure to pay any applicable taxes or required fees by the applicable deadline may result in the suspension or restriction of access to some or all of our services until the outstanding amount has been resolved.

s11.heading: 11. Indemnification
s11.text: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Foundation Exclusive and its officers, directors, employees, and agents from any claims, damages, losses, or expenses arising from your use of the Platform or violation of these Terms.

s12.heading: 12. Modifications to Terms
s12.text: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting. Your continued use of the Platform constitutes acceptance of the modified Terms.

s13.heading: 13. Governing Law
s13.text: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the jurisdiction in which Foundation Exclusive operates, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.

privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for Foundation Exclusive - Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy

s1.heading: 1. Introduction
s1.p1: Foundation Exclusive ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website and use our NFT marketplace services.
s1.p2: As an exclusive platform for high-value NFT collectors and creators, we understand the importance of maintaining the confidentiality and security of your personal and financial information.

personal.heading: Personal Information
items: Name and email address
Wallet addresses associated with your account
Profile information you choose to provide
Transaction history and NFT ownership records
Communication preferences

technical.heading: Technical Information
items: IP address and device identifiers
Browser type and version
Operating system
Pages visited and time spent on our platform
Referring website addresses

s3.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
s3.intro: We use the information we collect to:
items: Provide, operate, and maintain our marketplace services
Process transactions and send related information
Verify your identity and prevent fraud
Send you updates about your account and transactions
Respond to your comments, questions, and requests
Improve our platform and develop new features
Comply with legal obligations

s4.heading: 4. Information Sharing and Disclosure
s4.intro: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information in the following circumstances:

items.label: Blockchain Transactions:
items.text: NFT transactions are recorded on public blockchains and are visible to anyone.

items.label: Service Providers:
items.text: We may share information with trusted third-party service providers who assist in operating our platform.

items.label: Legal Requirements:
items.text: We may disclose information when required by law or to protect our rights.

s5.heading: 5. Data Security
s5.text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

s6.heading: 6. Your Rights
items: Access your personal information
Correct inaccurate or incomplete information
Request deletion of your personal information
Object to or restrict processing of your information
Data portability
Withdraw consent at any time

s7.heading: 7. Cookies and Tracking
s7.text: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience on our platform. For more information, please see our <cookieLink>Cookie Policy</cookieLink>.

s8.heading: 8. Changes to This Policy
s8.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.

s9.heading: 9. Contact Us
s9.intro: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

cookies.metaDescription: Cookie Policy for Foundation Exclusive - Learn about our use of cookies and tracking technologies.
cookies.heading: Cookie Policy

s1.heading: 1. What Are Cookies
s1.p1: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and provide information to website owners.
s1.p2: Foundation Exclusive uses cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience on our platform, understand how you use our services, and improve our offerings.

essential.heading: Essential Cookies
essential.text: These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly. They enable core functionality such as security, network management, and account access. You cannot opt out of these cookies.
items: Session management
Authentication and login
Security features
Load balancing

performance.heading: Performance Cookies
performance.text: These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website by collecting and reporting information anonymously.
items: Page load times
Error messages encountered
Pages visited
Time spent on pages

functionality.heading: Functionality Cookies
functionality.text: These cookies enable enhanced functionality and personalization, such as remembering your preferences.
items: Language preferences
Theme settings (dark/light mode)
Recently viewed items
User preferences

analytics.heading: Analytics Cookies
analytics.text: We use analytics cookies to gather insights about how our platform is used, which helps us improve our services.
items: Traffic sources
User behavior patterns
Feature usage statistics
Conversion tracking

s3.heading: 3. Third-Party Cookies
s3.p1: Some cookies on our platform are placed by third-party services that appear on our pages. We do not control these cookies.
s3.intro: Third-party services we may use include:

items.label: Google Analytics:
items.text: For understanding website traffic and usage patterns

items.label: Wallet Providers:
items.text: For cryptocurrency wallet connections and transactions

items.label: Social Media:
items.text: For sharing functionality and social login options

s4.heading: 4. How Long Do Cookies Last
s4.intro: Cookies can remain on your device for different periods:

items.label: Session Cookies:
items.text: These are temporary and are deleted when you close your browser.

items.label: Persistent Cookies:
items.text: These remain on your device for a set period (e.g., 30 days, 1 year) or until you delete them.

s5.heading: 5. Managing Cookies
s5.intro: You have several options for managing cookies:

browserSettings.heading: Browser Settings
browserSettings.intro: Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can:
items: View cookies stored on your device
Delete individual or all cookies
Block cookies from specific or all websites
Set preferences for first-party vs. third-party cookies

items.label: Chrome:
items.text: Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies and other site data

items.label: Firefox:
items.text: Options → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data

note.label: Note:
note.text: Disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our platform. Essential cookies cannot be disabled as they are required for the platform to function.

s6.heading: 6. Web3 and Blockchain Considerations
s6.intro: As an NFT marketplace, we interact with blockchain technology and cryptocurrency wallets. Please note:
items: Wallet connection data may be stored locally in your browser
Transaction signatures are processed through your wallet provider
Blockchain transactions are public and permanent, independent of cookies

s7.heading: 7. Updates to This Policy
s7.text: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.

s8.heading: 8. Contact Us
s8.intro: If you have questions about our use of cookies, please contact us:
